app.name: MapleMatch
app.description: AI-powered affordable housing matching platform for Canada.

home.hero: Find Your Affordable Home in Canada
home.subtitle: MapleMatch instantly matches you with available affordable housing, subsidies, co-ops, and waitlists across Canada.

features.title: Everything You Need to Find Housing
features.subtitle: MapleMatch combines eligibility rules, smart search, and AI to connect you with the right home — faster.

ai.title: AI-Powered Matching
ai.desc: Our engine analyses hundreds of factors to rank listings by your eligibility, preferences, and predicted wait time.

wizard.title: Eligibility Wizard
wizard.desc: A simple 4-step questionnaire captures your household details so we only surface housing you qualify for.

filters.title: Smart Search
filters.desc: Filter by city, province, rent, bedrooms, RGI status, and accessibility in real time.

notifications.title: Instant Alerts
notifications.desc: Get notified the moment a new listing matching your profile becomes available.

bilingual.title: Fully Bilingual
bilingual.desc: Available in English and French to serve every Canadian community.

accessible.title: Accessible by Design
accessible.desc: WCAG-compliant interface with accessible unit filtering and full screen-reader support.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From sign-up to your first match in minutes.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Answer a few quick questions about your income, household size, and housing preferences.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI scans available listings across Canada and ranks them by your eligibility and needs.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Review your top matches, see estimated wait times, and connect directly with housing providers.

finalCta.title: Ready to Find Your Home?
finalCta.subtitle: Join thousands of Canadians using MapleMatch to find affordable housing.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Here's an overview of your housing search.
dashboard.getStartedDesc: Fill out a quick questionnaire so we can match you with housing that fits your needs.

wizard.title: Eligibility Profile
wizard.subtitle: Tell us about yourself so we can find the right housing for you.

consent.title: Privacy & Consent
consent.description: MapleMatch collects your information to match you with affordable housing. Your data is handled in compliance with PIPEDA.
consent.point1: Your data is stored securely in Canadian data centres.
consent.point2: We will never share your information without your explicit consent.
consent.point3: You can delete your data at any time from your profile settings.
consent.agree: I consent to the collection and use of my data for housing matching.

matches.title: AI Matches
matches.subtitle: Smart matching powered by eligibility rules, semantic analysis, and machine learning.
matches.noResults: No matches found. Try updating your eligibility profile.

notifications.empty: You're all caught up — no notifications.
